query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as dpote_total,
  COUNT(*) as dias_total
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-morumbi') 
  AND data LIKE '2026-07%'
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
